tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// skyes rabs gsol 'debs mos gus kyi ba dan g.yo ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

'phags yul ljongs su rgyal ba shākya thub// slar yang nā gardzu na'i tshul dag las// zhing 'dir 'dren pa'i mchog gyur ratna shrī| |mnyam med bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin// padmas rjes bzung 'jigs med seṅge zhes// rig grol gnyis ldan khye'u dga' byed zhabs// bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog der gsol ba 'debs// 'chi med grub brnyes drang srong nyi ma mgon// zangs gling srid skyong rgyal po 'od mdzes zhabs// lnga rig paṇa chen lha yi zla ba zhes// grub brnyes mkhas pa gang der gsol ba 'debs// brtul zhugs mchog brnyes rakṣa tsaṇṭa dang*// tsa turmu kha'i grub mchog rgyal po'i zhabs// nges pa'i don rtogs me long rdo rje zhes// grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog der gsol ba 'debs// bhaṅga la ru chos rgyal legs byin mchog /rgya bod mkhas mchog paṇa chen chos kyi yid// rdo rje gdan pa chos kyi phreng ba'i zhabs// mkhas grub mang thos mchog der gsol ba 'debs// gnubs chung slob ma bande tshul khrims dang*// jo bo spyan drangs khu ston chos kyi rje// tshul khrims mchog mnga' gu ṇa ma ti'i zhabs// bslab gsum rgyal mtshan 'dzin der gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dpal khro chu'i rnal 'byor rdo rje grags// 'khor lo sdom pa'i grub brnyes hūm̐ ka ra// zhal bzhi bran khol grags pa ye shes zhabs// rim gnyis mthar son mchog der gsol ba 'debs// gtsug lag rtsis la mkhas pa legs grub dang*| |bla ma'i dgongs pa kun sgrub grags pa'i mchog /spros bral chos sku mngon gyur rin chen chos// gnyug ma'i don rtogs mchog der gsol ba 'debs// skyob pa'i dam chos mdzod 'dzin a ka ra// skad gnyis smra ba dpang lo blo gros zhabs// sgra rig mkhas mchog shong ston rdo rje'i mtshan// legs sbyar gzhung smra mchog la gsol ba 'debs// shākya mchog drung paṇa chen don yod zhes| |sgrub brgyud bstan 'dzin rdo rje rin chen dang*// gdung brgyud srid skyong sgom pa ratna'i mtshan// drang srong chos 'dzin mchog der gsol ba 'debs// rig pa 'dzin mchog rje btsun bi shwa'i zhabs|

|'gru rgyal rigs 'dir slar yang srid pa bzung*// de las myur ldog dharma kīrti zhes// tshul ldan mang thos mchog der gsol ba 'debs// 'di 'og don grub grags pa chos kyi 'bangs| |sngags 'chang chen po bdud 'dul grags pa dang*// rgya gar byang gling paṇa chen nyi ma'i snying*// gter 'byin mkhas pa'i mchog der gsol ba 'debs// klong yangs drung du bzhin bzang zla bas byin// rab gsal spyan sngar spobs pa'i snang ba can// ma 'ongs sangs rgyas dgu pa me tog zhes// 'byung 'gyur bstan pa'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs| |de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag sogs mos ldan 'gro ba ma lus pa// mnyam nyid gnyug ma chen po'i don rtogs nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa la 'god gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang chos mdzad do po sgang pas skye rabs kyi gsol 'debs zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor bgyis te/ ngan pa rang bstod kyi tshul du shākya'i dge slong dharma kīrtis sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ//
